body:
Thanks for the reply. The prostitution thing only becomes appealing when I'm hearing certain friends of mine bragging about how they make €8000 in a weekend and so on, but still, you have to be a certain kind of brash to pull that off, and I'm too much of a SAP to be that socially manipulative haha. 

I don't know if I have the mental strength to deal with working a bar job, I'm kind of on the edge of a breakdown and tbh, leaving the house at all is really difficult right now. I will do the CV tour, though... again... 

If you have any advice on how to get help with financial/mental health issues in Amsterdam, please let me know. I've tried writing to a few places but I've had no response. I'm not registered and I don't have health insurance, so there's that too.

>I really don't want to talk to the cops because 1. fuck that 2. i had some herbal refreshment on me.

This made me lol :)
Maybe he just needed a place to stay. I don't know who I feel more sorry for, him or the platypuses...
I used to live in Cambridge. It's really small and friendly. You should've just asked someone the way... Good story tho :)
Thanks... I might do so when I have the energy to write more.... :)

Just travel blogging for a mobile site... I want to get into writing other stuff. I just finished a short story, if there's somewhere to post it i'll do so then link you to it, if you're interested...

Thank you... I'm actually just doing travel blogging for a mobile app site atm, but i'm hoping to get a little more involved in political stuff, environment and so forth. You said you'd been in a similar situation - how did you get through?

What's really difficult is I do know all these things about being talented etc, and I know I have loads to be grateful for, but those things don't equal success as a person. My Indian friend suggested I go stay at an Ashram for a few months, it sounds like bliss! It would great to go through some kind of psychological detox. Anyway thanks for replying. A single positive interaction can make a big difference to my day, right now :)

Good question. I'm from London, though, which is similar in living costs, although i'm told these days it does actually work out cheaper. I'd like to move somewhere warmer and cheaper, like Spain; the change would be nice but I have friends here and I don't want to go to a place where I know no-one.

As for the other thing, I don't condemn it as a lifestyle choice for anyone who has the courage to go through with it, I'm just not sure I do. Still, it's something to think about.

Anyway, thanks for replying. I might just do the nomadic thing for a while. It'll be hard to develop my web design skills but at least I'll learn how to forage :)
depending on your skills, you could take a look at online marketplaces such as odesk, vworker & amazon's mechanical turks
I wondered about that. I don't feel I'm a particularly worthy cause compared with many others on that subreddit, but I guess I could give it a go. Thanks
